goals.title: A flat plate with holes
goals.summary: A flat plate with holes in it, sized in millimetres.
goals.text: Design a flat plate that is [length] millimetres long, [width] millimetres wide and [thickness] millimetres thick. Put [number of holes] holes of [hole size] millimetres across in [where the holes go]. Round the corners by [corner size] millimetres.

goals.title: A simple bracket
goals.summary: An L-shaped bracket with holes for fixing, sized in millimetres.
goals.text: Design a simple L-shaped bracket. One arm is [first arm length] millimetres long and the other is [second arm length] millimetres, [width] millimetres wide and [thickness] millimetres thick. Add [number of holes] fixing holes of [hole size] millimetres across.

goals.title: Change an earlier part
goals.summary: A new version of a part you already have, with only the change you name.
goals.text: Take the earlier part called [name of the earlier part] and make a new version of it. The only change is [what to change], by [amount] millimetres. Keep everything else as it was and keep the old version.

goals.title: A small animated character
goals.summary: A small character that moves, as a sheet of frames and an animated picture.
goals.text: Draw a small animated character: [who or what it is]. Each frame is [frame size] pixels square and there are [number of frames] frames of it [what it does]. Give me one sheet with all the frames, and an animated picture that plays them.

goals.title: A set of small icons
goals.summary: Several small icons drawn in one style and placed on a single sheet.
goals.text: Draw a set of [number of icons] small icons for [what they are for]: [list of the icons]. Each one is [icon size] pixels square, in one style with the colours [colours to use]. Put them all on one sheet.

goals.title: A badge or logo mark
goals.summary: A simple badge or logo mark as a vector image that scales cleanly.
goals.text: Draw a simple badge or logo mark for [name or subject]. Use [shape] as the main shape and the colours [colours to use]. Give it to me as a vector image that stays sharp at any size.
